interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Agentic Vault keeps plain-Markdown Obsidian memory, budgeted SessionStart handoffs, source-attributed recall, fail-closed git gates and verified backups shared across Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity CLI. Release v0.54.0 adds invisible Unicode smuggling/bidi stripping in SessionStart and vault_doctor, opt-in read-only hook-wiring auditing (vault_hook_wiring.py / vault_doctor --hook-wiring), deterministic vault install-state tracking and ownership-guarded uninstall (vault_install_state.py / vault_doctor --install-state), static CI hygiene/portability/workflow security tests, and a provenance-bound release claim verifier (scripts/verify_release_claims.py). Retained from v0.53.2 (which superseded the unpublished v0.53.1 candidate): BizRouter Decisions egress documented in SECURITY.md (bizrouter_client.py), Antigravity Stop documentation sync, vault_doctor credential redaction parity, scripts/first_handoff.py --help/--dir, 150-character TEMP Hypothesis extended-length paths, jarvis_bridge.py placeholder paths, scripts/run_unittest_parallel.py (4 stdlib workers), and git maintenance/APFS guard race fixes. Retained from v0.53.0: explicit Korean procedure order to break recall ties, first-handoff tutorial, and paired interrupted-work evaluation with separate scripted controls and participant scoring. No new runtime dependencies. Retained from v0.52.1: report-only health-check section 14d for duplicate ADR/M headings, defused SessionStart hook-header lines, kept primary Jev answers on --escalate-bizrouter with agreement and provider_disagreement, BizRouter narrowed to google/gemini-decision-1, and 150-character Windows long-TEMP fixes. Retained from v0.51.0: Windows paths beyond MAX_PATH, SessionStart credential redaction, Antigravity Stop deduplication, zero-issue fresh /vault-init vaults and the opt-in BizRouter Decisions adapter. Retained from v0.50.0: opt-in --worktree-heads lists linked worktrees whose detached HEAD no local branch or tag contains (its --help option realigns the six existing option lines by one column), and repository PR CI cancels superseded runs. The seven certificate-bound checker files are unchanged from v0.46.0 through v0.54.0. Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime; publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults. For transitions from v0.45.1 or earlier, where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
